name: Hontou no Negaigoto
source:
Yuichi is constantly late. As a penalty for yet another tardiness he is left to help library committee member to organize the shelves...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
佑一总是迟到。作为对又一次迟到的惩罚，他被留下来帮助图书馆委员会成员整理书架……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
